Name: Michaiah
Summary: Michaiah, son of Gemariah, heard Baruch read Jeremiah's roll in his father's chamber and reported all the words to the princes, who then sent for Baruch and heard the roll themselves.
KeyStory: Michaiah heard the words Baruch read and declared them to the princes in the scribe's chamber, setting in motion the reading before the king.
RelatedPeople: Gemariah, Son of Shaphan; Jeremiah; Baruch
LifeLesson: Repeating what you heard faithfully can be the first link in a chain that reaches the king.
